FM05.reasoning: The dataset contains time-series data from which temporal and rolling features were extracted, but the agent uses a random shuffled split instead of a time-based split, causing severe look-ahead bias.

FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates the model using only ROC-AUC and does not report other potentially relevant metrics like PR-AUC, F1-score, or accuracy.

other_failure_modes.name: Stateful features computed on test set without history
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes rolling statistics and lagged differences on the test set independently of the training set. This causes the first few rows of the test set to have incorrect or missing rolling/lagged features because they do not use the end of the training set as historical context.

summary: The agent correctly formulates the task and generates strong time-based and rolling features. However, it critically fails to respect temporal ordering during validation by using a shuffled StratifiedKFold, which introduces significant look-ahead bias. Additionally, stateful features are computed independently on the test set without incorporating the end of the training series, leading to inaccurate feature values at the beginning of the test set.
